$purpose: LITERAL, ready-to-paste style values for Shesha form nodes. Not tokens to resolve — the exact numbers and hexes that go into a component's desktop/tablet/mobile block. Composing from these is what produces a high-fidelity page; the app-level AntD theme cannot, because a per-component breakpoint block overrides it per-key (see references/style-channels.md).

$provenance.derivedFrom: boxfusion.test/bookings-table revision 2 — reviewed and approved as the fidelity bar
$provenance.status: starting set from one approved page. Extend it from the next approved page rather than inventing values.

$howToUse: Copy the literal block. Do not 'derive' it from a token file at build time — that indirection is where fidelity is lost.
Mirror across desktop/tablet/mobile unless the design is genuinely responsive; a value set only on desktop leaves tablet/mobile on the inherited base.
Everything on a page lives inside the page-shell card (shesha-form-edit/assets/blocks/page-shell.block.json).

surface.$use: any real surface — data table, card, panel. Border-forward with a whisper of shadow, never a heavy drop shadow.

titleBand.$use: page title + subtitle, directly inside the page shell, above everything else

toolbar.$use: search left, primary action right. Collapses to a column on mobile.

toolbarSearchCell.$use: the filling cell; width is calc(100% - actionCell - gap)

statusChip.$use: a reference-list status as a datatable cell or inline chip

dataColumn.$widths: give every column a minWidth; add width on short fixed columns (reference 130/140, date 130/150, status 130/150) and leave the wide text column on minWidth only
